mentions.note: won women's high jump at Surrey County Championships; only British girl to have cleared six feet; married Carl Lawton

photos.c: THE SUNDAY TIMES, MARCH 11 1973. It was an easy hurdle yesterday for Barbara Inkpen, only British girl to have cleared six feet. She is pictured negotiating a laughable height with her bridegroom, international race walker Carl Lawton, after their wedding at Farnham, Surrey
